sloka: आरोप्य अंके शिरः तस्य विललाप सुदुःखिता ।हा वानर महाराज हा नाथ माम् वत्सल ॥४-२५-४०॥
transliteration: āropya aṁke śiraḥ tasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā ।hā vānara mahārāja hā nātha mām vatsala ॥4-25-40॥

translations.english: 'Why don't you look at me, oppressed with tears, O monkey king, O my venerable lord, O longarmed one, O my dear?
